# InterestSeed

> A local-first interest validator for any Markdown vault.

InterestSeed turns saved notes into one testable connection. Your own local AI
suggests one connection at a time; a 3-day experiment decides whether to
continue, change direction, or drop it.

## What it does

- Reads any Markdown vault.
- Uses local AI with a narrow boundary: node ids, titles, tags and existing
  edge pairs only.
- Suggests one connection, not a batch of pending cards.
- Runs a 3-day experiment with one real observation per day.
- Keeps the human in control: connect, skip, change the relation, or undo.
- Ships as CLI, local web, agent skill and read-only MCP.
